Annika, saw Clearstory closed a $16M Series B and rolled out across 350-plus Turner Construction jobsites.

Scaling pipeline that fast usually means more accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Clearstory off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Annika, quick follow-up for Clearstory.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline jump faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Clearstory needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Annika, last bit of proof for Clearstory.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Clearstory's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B construction-tech startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-B motion? I will tailor it to Clearstory either way.
